# Gabriel Digital Studio

> Gabriel Digital Studio is a one-person freelance web design studio based in London, UK. It designs and builds websites, brand identities and Google Business Profiles for small businesses (cafés, barbers, clinics, trades, boutiques and other local services) that are great in person but hard to find or unconvincing online. Work is done in person across London and remotely for small businesses anywhere in the UK. Prices are in GBP.

## Key facts

- Business: Gabriel Digital Studio (freelance web designer, sole practitioner: you work directly with Gabriel, no agency or account managers)
- Location: London, United Kingdom. Serves London in person and the rest of the UK remotely
- Who it's for: small and independent businesses, especially local service businesses that need more calls, bookings and Google Maps visibility
- Services: web design and build, brand identity, local SEO and Google Business Profile, social media kit
- Typical timeline: about four weeks from first call to launch
- Prices: from £795 (one-page site) to £2,450 (full rebuild with branding); optional £59/month care plan
- Ownership: the client owns their domain, website, logins and design files
- First step: a free 30-minute discovery call
- Website: https://gabrieldigitalstudio.com/
- Contact: the enquiry form at https://gabrieldigitalstudio.com/#contact (replies within one business day)

## Services

- **Web design: A site that gets you calls.** Fast, mobile-first pages built around the one thing you want visitors to do: call, book or buy.
- **Brand identity: A look that holds together.** Logo refresh, colours, type and a one-page brand guide so everything you hand out matches.
- **Local SEO: Found on Google Maps.** A claimed and complete Google Business Profile, cleaned-up listings and a simple review routine.
- **Social kit: Posts that look pro.** Profile art, editable templates and photo direction, so posting takes five minutes, not an evening.

## Packages and pricing (GBP)

### Spark: £795 one-off

For new businesses that need to look legitimate fast.

- One-page website with a contact or booking button
- Mobile-first design, built to load in under 2 seconds
- Google Business Profile set up and verified
- Domain and email connected

### Presence: £2,450 one-off

The full rebuild: one identity across every place customers find you.

- Website of up to 6 pages, with copywriting help
- Logo refresh, colour palette and brand guide
- Google profile optimisation and local SEO basics
- Social profile kit with 6 editable post templates
- Two rounds of revisions

### Care plan: £59 per month

Keep it fast, secure and current after launch.

- Hosting, SSL, updates and daily backups handled
- Up to 1 hour of edits each month
- Monthly speed and Google profile report
- Cancel anytime and keep everything

Every project starts with a free 30-minute call. Payment is split 50% to start and 50% at launch.

## Process

1. **Discovery call** (Week 0): 30 minutes on what you sell, who buys it and what’s broken today.
2. **Identity & plan** (Week 1): Moodboard, page map and copy direction. You approve before anything gets built.
3. **Design & build** (Weeks 2–3): A private preview link you can tap through on your phone, with two rounds of changes.
4. **Launch & handover** (Week 4): We go live, connect your Google profile, and you get a short training call. You own everything.

## Frequently asked questions

### I don’t have a logo yet. Is that a problem?

No. The Presence package includes a logo refresh, and I can design a simple mark from scratch if you’re starting fresh. Spark clients can add a logo for a fixed £450.

### Do I have to write all the text myself?

You give me the facts in a short questionnaire and our call. I shape that into clear, friendly copy and send it to you for approval.

### I already have a website. Do we start over?

Not always. If your current platform is sound, I redesign on top of it. If it’s slow or hard to edit, I’ll explain why a rebuild costs less in the long run.

### Can I update the site myself after launch?

Yes. You get a simple editor for text, photos, hours and prices, plus a short recorded walkthrough so you never feel stuck.

### Who owns the website and domain?

You do. The domain is registered in your name, and every login and design file is handed over at launch, whether or not you join the care plan.

### How do I get more Google reviews?

I set up a short review link and QR code you can put on receipts, the counter or follow-up messages. Asking at the right moment does most of the work.

### How much does a small business website cost in London?

Most of my clients spend between £795 for a one-page site and £2,450 for a full rebuild with branding and local SEO. You get a fixed quote after our free call, so there are no surprises.

### How long does it take to build a website?

About four weeks from our first call to launch. A one-page Spark site can be live in as little as two weeks if your content is ready.

### Do you only work with businesses in London?

I’m based in London and happy to meet in person anywhere in the city. I also work remotely with small businesses across the UK, with calls, previews and sign-off all online.
